verification.hardwareEvidence: Inherited from the immediately preceding 0.38.4e candidate under the documented pre-1.0 version-only promotion rule. That exact candidate was programmed through Atmel-ICE J41800053674 on the representative AVR128DA48 receiver, independently read back byte-for-byte, and confirmed to preserve EEPROM, fuses, lock bits, and user row. Operator testing confirmed responsive UI and D999 W0L0 while near-threshold listening; no additional hardware testing was performed at the release owner's direction. Only SW_REVISION changed for 0.38.5, and the exact unsuffixed image was not programmed. See release-notes/v0.38.5.md.
